posts.title: The Front Door and the Workshop
posts.description: Agents are becoming the front door to software. The app becomes the workshop for people with taste. Design both intentionally.

posts.title: Your Memory is Someone Else's Asset
posts.description: Every app is becoming a tool your AI can use. Your assistant will know more about you and do more on your behalf. Who owns that memory, and who holds the approve button?

posts.title: The Story of ArtCraft and What it Means for Software Moats
posts.description: If any software can be reverse engineered and rebuilt, the moat was never the code. Here's where the value actually went.
